description: Repo-level additions to the fleet's central Renovate config.

harness/vet-fixtures/** holds frozen evidence from harness vets: seed projects and run outputs that are recorded as they were run, and no CI job installs them. Renovate kept opening PRs against their package.json files (#486, #637, #727); bumping them rewrites the evidence, so Renovate does not manage them.
plugins/** is not ignored: plugins/product-video and the other real plugins stay managed.
ignorePaths replaces the config:recommended list rather than adding to it, so that list is repeated here.

plugins/product-video's remotion-versions test requires every Remotion package at one version (#674). Separate PRs each moved one package and failed it, holding all three PR slots from 2026-11-19 (#786, #787, #790), so Remotion updates come as one PR.
